home.partner.benefit.1.title: Tell cultural stories, not just sell tickets
home.partner.benefit.1.text: Every stop includes cultural stories and artifacts with photos and videos. Stories unlock when travelers arrive, giving every trip deeper meaning.
home.partner.benefit.2.title: Interactive experiences on site
home.partner.benefit.2.text: Quizzes and real-world activities verified by QR code and GPS location, complete with reward points in the JourneyGo app.
home.partner.benefit.3.title: Fast tour creation with auto-drafts
home.partner.benefit.3.text: Create tours in 5 guided steps or import an entire tour from an Excel template. Update ticket prices and departure schedules even while live.
home.partner.benefit.4.title: Transparent revenue and settlements
home.partner.benefit.4.text: Track bookings, revenue, settlement periods and wallet balance right in the partner portal. Payouts go directly to your registered bank account.
home.partner.process.1.title: Submit your application
home.partner.process.1.text: Complete 4 steps: representative details, business profile, payout account, and agreement. Your application auto-saves as a draft after email verification.
home.partner.process.2.title: Admin review
home.partner.process.2.text: Our team reviews applications within 1–3 business days. If anything is missing, you'll receive an email with the reason so you can update and resubmit.
home.partner.process.3.title: Build your tour in 5 steps
home.partner.process.3.text: Once approved, you'll get an email to set your password, sign in to the partner portal, and create tours: details, pricing, destinations, itinerary, and departures.
home.partner.process.4.title: Go live and welcome travelers
home.partner.process.4.text: Each tour is reviewed against 5 content criteria before going live. Approved tours appear on both the website and the traveler app.
home.partner.faq.1.q: Is there a fee to register as a partner?
home.partner.faq.1.a: No. Registering and using the partner portal is completely free, with no minimum revenue requirement. JourneyGo charges a commission on each completed booking according to the applicable partner commission policy.
home.partner.faq.2.q: How long does the review take?
home.partner.faq.2.a: Usually 1–3 business days. The result will be sent to the email address you verified during registration.
home.partner.faq.3.q: I'm a household business or artisan — can I apply?
home.partner.faq.3.a: Yes. Choose "Experience / destination host" and upload your household business registration certificate along with your operating license.
home.partner.faq.4.q: I already have a traveler account — can I use it as a partner account?
home.partner.faq.4.a: No. Your partner account is created after approval using a separate business email. You can keep using your traveler account to book tours as usual.
home.partner.faq.5.q: What if my application needs additional information?
home.partner.faq.5.a: You'll receive an email specifying what needs to be added and why. After updating your details, you can resubmit for review.
home.partner.faq.6.q: Once approved, can my tours go on sale immediately?
home.partner.faq.6.a: Every tour you create goes through a content review before going live. Once approved, travelers can book any of your scheduled departure dates.
home.partner.faq.7.q: Can I update my business info or bank account later?
home.partner.faq.7.a: Yes. You can submit an update request from the partner portal; changes take effect once confirmed by an administrator.
home.partner.faq.8.q: What file formats are accepted for documents?
home.partner.faq.8.a: Photos (PNG, JPG) or PDF files, up to 10MB each. Please make sure the document is clear with all four corners visible.

home.partner.hero.emailNote: Partner accounts use a separate business email, distinct from traveler accounts.

home.pr.terms.title: JourneyGo Partner Cooperation Terms
home.pr.terms.s1.p1: These Terms apply to all Partners (travel agencies, attractions, accommodations, tourism household businesses, and other tourism service providers) registering and offering services on the JourneyGo platform.
home.pr.terms.s1.p2: "JourneyGo" is an intermediary platform connecting travelers with Partners. "Partner" is an organization or individual registering to cooperate and bearing responsibility for the products and services they provide.
home.pr.terms.s1.p3: Registering and using a Partner account constitutes acceptance of and compliance with all JourneyGo Terms, security regulations, and policies.
home.pr.terms.s2.p1: Partners must provide accurate, complete, and verifiable profile information, including business/household name, tax code, operating license, business registration certificate, headquarters address, and legal representative details.
home.pr.terms.s2.p2: Partners are responsible for verifying their representative via a verification code (OTP) sent to the registered email address. Completing registration with the OTP serves as evidence that the Partner confirms representative authority.
home.pr.terms.s2.p3: JourneyGo reserves the right to reject, request additional documents for, or suspend an application if any information is found to be inaccurate, unlawful, forged, or in violation of applicable laws.
home.pr.terms.s3.p1: Deliver products and services matching the published quality, description, itinerary, and committed value; strictly no fraud, hidden fees, or coercion of customers.
home.pr.terms.s3.p2: Comply with laws on tourism, accommodation, transport, commerce, taxes, invoices, and vouchers; take responsibility for personnel, safety, and insurance for customers.
home.pr.terms.s3.p3: Respond to, support, and resolve customer complaints within a reasonable timeframe; promptly notify JourneyGo of any changes to legal documents, licenses, bank details, or contact information.
home.pr.terms.s3.p4: Do not collect, use, or share customer data for any purpose other than delivering registered services, unless authorized in writing by the customer.
home.pr.terms.s4.p1: JourneyGo provides the technology platform, customer connection infrastructure, booking management tools, revenue reports, and operational support for Partners.
home.pr.terms.s4.p2: JourneyGo reserves the right to review profiles, monitor service quality, hide or remove non-compliant listings, and notify or suspend Partners in the event of violations.
home.pr.terms.s4.p3: JourneyGo is not liable for damages arising from a Partner's actions or failure to deliver services as committed.
home.pr.terms.s5.p1: Commission rates and fees are publicly listed under the active policy at the time a booking is created. Policy changes do not apply retroactively to existing bookings.
home.pr.terms.s5.p2: JourneyGo reconciles revenue periodically and transfers payouts to the Partner's registered bank account, less applicable fees, taxes, or valid deductions.
home.pr.terms.s5.p3: Partners are responsible for declaring and paying all taxes arising from cooperation revenue accurately and on time, and for providing accurate financial information for any statutory withholding or reporting by JourneyGo.
home.pr.terms.s6.p1: Each party agrees to keep the other party's information confidential and use it solely for its stated purpose. Partners consent to JourneyGo collecting, storing, and processing personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Policy.
home.pr.terms.s6.p2: Partners are responsible for securing their management accounts, never sharing passwords or OTP codes, and immediately notifying JourneyGo upon detecting unauthorized access.
home.pr.terms.s7.p1: Partners may voluntarily terminate cooperation in writing; JourneyGo will process the request within a reasonable timeframe and settle outstanding amounts accrued prior to termination.
home.pr.terms.s7.p2: JourneyGo may suspend or terminate cooperation if a Partner commits serious or repeated violations, harms platform reputation, or upon request from competent authorities.
home.pr.terms.s7.p3: Termination does not affect financial, confidentiality, or indemnification obligations accrued prior to the termination date.
home.pr.terms.s8.p1: Except in cases of willful misconduct or gross negligence, neither party is liable for indirect damages, data loss, or business interruption arising from the system.
home.pr.terms.s8.p2: JourneyGo is not liable for damages caused by legal violations, third-party service provider failures, or force majeure events.
home.pr.terms.s9.h: Article 9 — Dispute Resolution and Governing Law
home.pr.terms.s9.p1: Any dispute arising from or related to these Terms shall first be resolved through negotiation and mediation. If unresolved, either party may submit the dispute to a competent court where the Partner is registered.
home.pr.terms.s9.p2: These Terms are governed by the laws of Vietnam. Any updates will be announced at least 7 days in advance through JourneyGo's official channels.
home.pr.privacy.title: Personal Data Protection Policy
home.pr.privacy.s1.p1: This policy applies to all individuals and organizations registering as partners, using services, or contacting JourneyGo via the website, mobile app, hotline, or support channels.
home.pr.privacy.s1.p2: Data we collect includes: full name, position, phone number, email address, photos and documents (operating license, business/household registration), headquarters address (Province/City – Ward/Commune), tax code, bank details, and scope of operations.
home.pr.privacy.s1.p3: We also collect minimal technical data such as IP address, device type, browser, and interaction logs to ensure system security.
home.pr.privacy.s2.p1: Verify the representative's identity and authority via OTP; receive and process partner applications.
home.pr.privacy.s2.p2: Verify legal documents, licenses, and tax codes, and detect fraud or invalid applications.
home.pr.privacy.s2.p3: Create and maintain Partner accounts, provide platform services, and manage bookings, revenue, and commissions.
home.pr.privacy.s2.p4: Send transaction and security notifications, provide customer support, and handle complaints.
home.pr.privacy.s2.p5: Comply with legal, tax, and regulatory obligations, and cooperate with authorities upon lawful request.
home.pr.privacy.s3.p1: Data processing is based on your consent, the performance of contracts you enter into, and compliance with applicable legal obligations.
home.pr.privacy.s4.p1: Data is processed by JourneyGo and authorized infrastructure providers: OTP email providers, file storage providers, payment processors, and technical support services.
home.pr.privacy.s4.p2: We do not sell, trade, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. Sharing occurs only with your consent, as required by law, or to protect JourneyGo's legitimate rights.
home.pr.privacy.s5.p1: Data is retained throughout the cooperation period and for as long as required by law (including statutory retention periods for accounting, tax, and partner records).
home.pr.privacy.s5.p2: When there is no longer a legal basis to retain data, it will be deleted or anonymized in accordance with JourneyGo's data management procedures.
home.pr.privacy.s6.p1: JourneyGo applies appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data: encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS), role-based access control, access logs, backups, and staff security training.
home.pr.privacy.s6.p2: Passwords and OTP codes are stored encrypted/hashed and are never displayed in full on the system.
home.pr.privacy.s7.p1: You have the right to be informed about the personal data collected and processing purposes, and the right to access, review, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your data.
home.pr.privacy.s7.p2: You may withdraw your consent at any time; withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.
home.pr.privacy.s7.p3: You have the right to lodge complaints regarding data processing. We will respond within statutory timelines and assist you in exercising your rights under the Personal Data Protection Law.
home.pr.privacy.s8.p1: Personal data is primarily stored on infrastructure located in Vietnam. Where overseas third-party services are used, we implement appropriate safeguards in compliance with the law.
home.pr.privacy.s9.p1: This policy may be updated when laws or operational needs change. Updates will be announced via the website or email before taking effect.
home.pr.privacy.s10.p1: For any questions regarding this Personal Data Protection Policy, please contact JourneyGo's Data & Security team via the support email listed on the website or through our contact form.
